subject: NexaCare — launch responsibilities, timeline & risk items
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, tessa_morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, rafael_mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>, Asha Rao <asha.rao@nexacare.health>, Bryce Moore <bryce.moore@nexacare.health>
Date: Tue, 12 May 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: NexaCare — launch responsibilities, timeline & risk items

Hey team —

Thanks for the quick close last week. Per our commercial agreement (SOW v3 attached) NexaCare is targeting a phased roll‑out starting the week of 6/21. They asked that we provide a compact launch plan and clear owner assignments so they can align internal stakeholders. High level details: 

- Scope: Document ingestion + prompt templates + 3 prebuilt dashboards (analytics, latency, cost)
- Target initial users: 15 internal ops users, then 3 pilot external partners
- SLA: 99.5% monthly; error budget conversation scheduled post‑kickoff

Immediate asks for CS/implementation: 
1) Owner for kickoff (exec and day‑to‑day) — they requested a single point of contact for escalation.
2) Required assets from NexaCare: production API whitelist, SSO metadata, initial test dataset (anonymized)
3) Security/PCI concerns — they flagged a compliance checklist; procurement will follow up.

Known risks / open items:
- Procurement wants a one‑page data handling addendum before we provision a private VPC.
- NexaCare has a strict retention policy (30 days) for pilot data — confirm if our cache TTLs can be adjusted per customer.
- Two of their pilot partners are in EU — may require region routing decisions.

I've attached the latest SOW and a security matrix they asked for. Assignments below are my suggested defaults; feel free to reassign.

Suggested owners: 
- Kickoff & exec sponsor: Marissa Cole (CS Lead)
- Day‑to‑day technical owner: Tessa Morgan (Implementation PM)
- Infra provisioning & VPC: Vivek Kulkarni (Infra Eng)
- Contract & finance touchpoint: Rafael Mendes (Sales Ops)

Next step: Marissa — can you confirm owners and propose a 45‑minute kickoff slot next week?

Thanks —
Karthik
Account Exec | Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, tessa_morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, rafael_mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>, Asha Rao <asha.rao@nexacare.health>, Bryce Moore <bryce.moore@nexacare.health>
Date: Tue, 12 May 2026 12:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: NexaCare — launch responsibilities, timeline & risk items

Thanks Karthik — this looks good. I can be the exec sponsor and take the kickoff leadership role. A few clarifying items before I lock dates: 

- Retention: We can set application‑level cache TTLs down to 24 hours; per‑customer KV cache purges are possible but need an ops window. I’ll coordinate with Vivek.
- VPC: If procurement requires a customer‑managed private VPC, we need to confirm who will own the peering and whether NexaCare wants dedicated residency (additional fees). Rafael, can you share negotiation notes from the contract?
- Pilot partners in EU: recommend we route those requests to our EU region to avoid complexity for the pilot. Vivek, can you confirm EU capacity?

I’ll propose owners and a 45‑minute window for kickoff. Tessa — I need a draft agenda that covers acceptance criteria, data handoff, SSO, and the success metrics we’ll use at 30/60/90 days. Can you also prepare an intake checklist and a one‑page runbook for the pilot?

Marissa Cole
Director, Customer Success | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
Attach: NexaCare_SOW_v3.pdf, NexaCare-security-matrix.xlsx
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>, Asha Rao <asha.rao@nexacare.health>
Date: Wed, 13 May 2026 10:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: NexaCare — launch responsibilities, timeline & risk items

Marissa / team —

I can lead the kickoff and the implementation sprints. Draft agenda (45 mins):
- 0–10m: Introductions + success metrics (Marissa lead)
- 10–20m: Security & compliance touchpoints (Vivek + Asha)
- 20–30m: Data handoff requirements & sample dataset (Tessa)
- 30–40m: Rollout plan for pilot partners + region routing (Vivek)
- 40–45m: Actions, owners, timing

Deliverables I’ll own before kickoff: 
- Intake checklist (what we need from customer to start) — due 5/18
- Pilot runbook (ops steps + rollback) — due 5/20
- Integration test plan for SSO & API whitelist — due 5/20

Risks and mitigations: 
- Procurement addendum: ask Rafael to confirm acceptable language and ownership of legal review.
- Cache TTLs: If they insist on 30‑day retention for logs, we may need a signed exception; suggest we offer a 30‑day data retention for persistent storage only (not cache).
- EU partners: propose pilot traffic be kept under 10% of overall requests to limit compliance surface area.

Proposed kickoff slots (all PT):
- Thu 5/21 10:00–10:45
- Fri 5/22 09:30–10:15
- Mon 5/25 11:00–11:45

Marissa — pick one and I’ll send the invite and pre‑read.

—Tessa
Implementation Program Manager | Redwood Inference
From: Asha Rao <asha.rao@nexacare.health>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, tessa_morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Bryce Moore <bryce.moore@nexacare.health>, procurement@nexacare.health
Date: Thu, 14 May 2026 16:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: NexaCare — launch responsibilities, timeline & risk items

Thanks Karthik and Marissa — appreciate the clear breakdown. 

We can do Thu 5/21 10:00 PT for kickoff. A few notes from our side in advance: 
- Procurement wants the one‑page addendum this week; I’ll attach their redline to the meeting invite.
- We will share a sanitized sample dataset by EOD 5/18 (PII removed).
- For SSO we are using Okta; I’ll include SAML metadata in the shared folder.

Quick answers: we are comfortable with a 24‑hour cache TTL for the pilot; retention policy refers to persisted logs only. EU pilot partners are located in Ireland and Germany — prefer EU routing but understand throttling for pilot.

Looking forward to 5/21.

Best,
Asha Rao
VP Product Operations | NexaCare
asha.rao@nexacare.health
Attach: NexaCare_procurement_redline.pdf
